Title: Automation: Updated ARM modules shipping in the service

Body.Content:
Azure Automation has released the latest versions of these Azure ARM modules to Automation accounts:
  • AzureRM.Automation
  • AzureRM.Compute
  • AzureRM.Profile
  • AzureRM.Resources
  • AzureRM.Sql
  • AzureRM.Storage
  • Azure.Storage
The Automation, Resources, SQL, and Storage modules are available for the first time as the service increases the number of Azure ARM modules that are available in Automation accounts.
